changelog: The player's clock lines up with the video title.
Updates now come from MeeTube TV's own repository.
Home: bigger cards set closer together, bigger clock and category chips.
Card previews on Home are off by default.
Smaller player controls, with arrows when more buttons are hidden.
The sidebar glass reaches the bottom and the chips no longer flicker.
A focused Shorts card no longer runs into the row below it.
Videos open almost at once: the video under focus loads while you look at its card.
The focused card glows with a white ring and a lit title.
AV1 video on TVs that decode it in hardware: smaller downloads, fewer stalls.
No more stops with "PoToken attestation failed".
About 50 MB less memory while a preview or video plays.
SponsorBlock asks before skipping a segment.
Home chips as one segmented track, and a simpler player.
In-app updates: MeeTube TV now finds and installs its own new versions.
Shorts player, and a Shorts feed picked for your account.
Bigger focused cards that never touch their neighbours.
Videos start faster, with a larger buffer by default.
Subscriptions page with round channel avatars and an All item.
Home: explore pills, a roomier glass sidebar and fades on both row ends.
